    72	function verifyHs256(
    73	  token: string,
    74	  secret: string,
    75	): JwtPayload {
    76	  const parts =
    77	    token.split('.');
    78	
    79	  if (parts.length !== 3) {
    80	    throw new UnauthorizedException(
    81	      'Invalid authentication token',
    82	    );
    83	  }
    84	
    85	  const [
    86	    encodedHeader,
    87	    encodedPayload,
    88	    encodedSignature,
    89	  ] = parts;
    90	
    91	  let header: {
    92	    alg?: unknown;
    93	    typ?: unknown;
    94	  };
    95	
    96	  let payload:
    97	    JwtPayload;
    98	
    99	  let supplied:
   100	    Buffer;
   101	
   102	  try {
   103	    header =
   104	      parseJson(
   105	        decode(encodedHeader),
   106	      );
   107	
   108	    payload =
   109	      parseJson(
   110	        decode(encodedPayload),
   111	      );
   112	
   113	    supplied =
   114	      decode(
   115	        encodedSignature,
   116	      );
   117	  } catch {
   118	    throw new UnauthorizedException(
   119	      'Invalid authentication token',
   120	    );
   121	  }
   122	
   123	  if (
   124	    header.alg !== 'HS256'
   125	  ) {
   126	    throw new UnauthorizedException(
   127	      'Unsupported authentication algorithm',
   128	    );
   129	  }
   130	
   131	  const expected =
   132	    createHmac(
   133	      'sha256',
   134	      secret,
   135	    )
   136	      .update(
   137	        `${encodedHeader}.${encodedPayload}`,
   138	      )
   139	      .digest();
   140	
   141	  if (
   142	    expected.length !==
   143	      supplied.length ||
   144	    !timingSafeEqual(
   145	      expected,
   146	      supplied,
   147	    )
   148	  ) {
   149	    throw new UnauthorizedException(
   150	      'Invalid authentication signature',
   151	    );
   152	  }
   153	
   154	  const now =
   155	    Math.floor(
   156	      Date.now() / 1000,
   157	    );
   158	
   159	  if (
   160	    typeof payload.exp ===
   161	      'number' &&
   162	    payload.exp <= now
   163	  ) {
   164	    throw new UnauthorizedException(
   165	      'Authentication token expired',
   166	    );
   167	  }
   168	
   169	  if (
   170	    typeof payload.nbf ===
   171	      'number' &&
   172	    payload.nbf > now
   173	  ) {
   174	    throw new UnauthorizedException(
   175	      'Authentication token not active',
   176	    );
   177	  }
   178	
   179	  if (
   180	    typeof payload.sub !==
   181	      'string' ||
   182	    payload.sub.trim().length === 0
   183	  ) {
   184	    throw new UnauthorizedException(
   185	      'Authentication subject is required',
   186	    );
   187	  }
   188	
   189	  if (
   190	    typeof payload.role !==
   191	      'string' ||
   192	    !VALID_ROLES.has(
   193	      payload.role as ActorRole,
   194	    )
   195	  ) {
   196	    throw new UnauthorizedException(
   197	      'Authentication role is invalid',
   198	    );
   199	  }
   200	
   201	  if (
   202	    typeof payload.jti !==
   203	      'string' ||
   204	    payload.jti.trim().length === 0
   205	  ) {
   206	    throw new UnauthorizedException(
   207	      'Authentication session is required',
   208	    );
   209	  }
   210	
   211	  return payload;
   212	}

    87	let ProductionAuthMiddleware = class ProductionAuthMiddleware {
    88	    constructor(db) {
    89	        this.db = db;
    90	    }
    91	    async use(req, _res, next) {
    92	        if (process.env.NODE_ENV !==
    93	            'production') {
    94	            next();
    95	            return;
    96	        }
    97	        const path = req.originalUrl
    98	            .split('?')[0];
    99	        if (path ===
   100	            '/api/auth/login' ||
   101	            path ===
   102	                '/api/health' ||
   103	            path ===
   104	                '/api/health/live' ||
   105	            path ===
   106	                '/api/health/ready') {
   107	            next();
   108	            return;
   109	        }
   110	        const secret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
   111	        if (!secret ||
   112	            secret.length < 32) {
   113	            throw new common_1.UnauthorizedException('Production authentication is not configured');
   114	        }
   115	        const authorization = req.header('authorization');
   116	        if (!authorization ||
   117	            !authorization.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
   118	            throw new common_1.UnauthorizedException('Bearer authentication is required');
   119	        }
   120	        const token = authorization
   121	            .slice('Bearer '.length)
   122	            .trim();
   123	        const payload = verifyHs256(token, secret);
   124	        const actorId = payload.sub;
   125	        const actorRole = payload.role;
   126	        const sessionId = payload.jti;
   127	        const session = await this.db.query(`
   128	        SELECT
   129	          actor_id,
   130	          actor_role
   131	        FROM auth_sessions
   132	        WHERE session_id = $1
   133	          AND actor_id = $2
   134	          AND actor_role = $3
   135	          AND revoked_at IS NULL
   136	          AND expires_at > now()
   137	        LIMIT 1
   138	        `, [
   139	            sessionId,
   140	            actorId,
   141	            actorRole,
   142	        ]);
   143	        if (session.rows.length !== 1) {
   144	            throw new common_1.UnauthorizedException('Authentication session is not active');
   145	        }
   146	        req.headers['x-actor-id'] = actorId;
   147	        req.headers['x-actor-role'] = actorRole;
   148	        req.headers['x-auth-session-id'] = sessionId;
   149	        next();
   150	    }
   151	};
